card.name: Linking words before clotting terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "on" and "affect" right before a clotting or bleeding term like prothrombin time, INR, bleeding or hemostasis. Mostly seen in warfarin interaction and low-platelet text.

modes.label: Effect of warfarin on lab value
modes.description: The word "on" after "effect of warfarin" or "effect", just before prothrombin time or INR.
modes.example: ketoprofen did not significantly interfere with the effect of warfarin<< on>> prothrombin time.

modes.label: Words leading into bleeding control
modes.description: A word just before bleeding or hemostasis, such as "to" in ability to control bleeding or "affect" before hemostasis.
modes.example: Compromised ability<< to>> control bleeding if platelets counts are low

card.writes: It pushes the model toward clotting words like clot, plate(let) and blood as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a clotting or bleeding term is expected, as in warfarin effects on INR.
